boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations in Claremont Village and the Packing House area, west of the Claremont Colleges.

cards.entity_name: Benton Museum of Art at Pomona College
cards.title: Benton Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor, Claremont Village
cards.notes: Walk to 211 N. College Ave. and use the museum’s current exhibition listings to plan a focused art stop.
cards.short_summary: A college art museum on the Village-facing edge of Pomona College.
cards.evidence_claim: The Benton Museum of Art is located at 211 N. College Ave. in Claremont.
cards.source_title: Benton Museum of Art at Pomona College
cards.access_notes: Check the museum website for current visitor information and exhibition access.

cards.title: Claremont Lewis Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: West First Street corridor, Claremont Depot
cards.notes: Find the museum at the Claremont Depot and check its exhibition calendar before making the short walk from campus.
cards.short_summary: A local-art museum housed at the historic Claremont Depot.
cards.evidence_claim: Claremont Lewis Museum of Art is at 200 W. First St., in the Claremont Depot.
cards.access_notes: Consult the museum’s current calendar for open dates and exhibitions.

cards.title: Folk Music Center
cards.subtitle: Yale Avenue corridor, Claremont Village
cards.notes: Stop at 220 Yale Ave. to browse the instrument shop and review the center’s event information before attending anything.
cards.short_summary: An instrument shop and music-focused Village destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Folk Music Center lists its Claremont location at 220 Yale Ave.
cards.access_notes: Retail purchases and any separately listed events may have costs.

cards.title: Laemmle Claremont 5
cards.subtitle: Indian Hill Boulevard corridor, Village Square
cards.notes: Check the theater’s live showtime page, then choose a screening at the five-screen cinema in Village Square.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled-film stop in the center of Claremont Village.
cards.evidence_claim: Laemmle operates the Claremont 5 theater at Village Square in Claremont.
cards.access_notes: Ticket purchase is required; verify showtimes and ratings on the theater page.

cards.title: Claremont Packing House
cards.subtitle: West First Street corridor, Claremont Village
cards.notes: Use the Packing House directory to select one current shop, food counter, or creative business before you head over.
cards.short_summary: A named First Street complex with shops, dining, and creative businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village directory identifies businesses at the Packing House on W. First Street.
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own hours and purchase requirements.

cards.title: Claremont Village Square
cards.subtitle: Indian Hill Boulevard corridor, Claremont Village
cards.notes: Use the landscaped public plaza and fountain as a meeting point, then continue to a listed shop, café, or theater nearby.
cards.short_summary: A central Village plaza with public seating and an interactive fountain.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Square describes a landscaped public plaza with an interactive fountain and outdoor seating.
cards.access_notes: The plaza is public; nearby businesses and theater activities may require purchases.

cards.title: The Hens' Kitchen Shoppe
cards.subtitle: Yale Avenue corridor, Claremont Village
cards.notes: Browse cookware, bakeware, cookbooks, and pantry goods at 141 Yale Ave.; verify its current opening times before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A Village kitchen-goods shop with cookware, cookbooks, and pantry items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hens' Kitchen Shoppe lists 141 Yale Ave. and describes kitchen goods, cookbooks, and pantry categories.
cards.access_notes: Browsing does not require a purchase; merchandise is sold on site.

cards.title: Some Crust Bakery & Cafe
cards.subtitle: Yale Avenue corridor, Claremont Village
cards.notes: Meet at 119 Yale Ave. for bakery or café service, using the business’s current menu and ordering details to choose a visit.
cards.short_summary: A named bakery-and-café stop in the Yale Avenue stretch of the Village.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village directory lists Some Crust Bakery & Cafe at 119 Yale Ave.
cards.access_notes: Food and drink are purchased; check the business directly for current service details.

cards.title: Claremont Forum Bookshop & Gallery
cards.subtitle: West First Street corridor, Claremont Packing House
cards.notes: Browse the bookshop and gallery at the Packing House, then check the store’s site for any scheduled author or community events.
cards.short_summary: A bookshop-and-gallery destination inside the Packing House.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village arts directory lists Claremont Forum Bookshop & Gallery at 586 W. First St.
cards.access_notes: Books and other merchandise are sold; event access varies by listing.

cards.entity_name: Lost Levels Sports Card Shop & TCG
cards.title: Lost Levels Sports Card Shop & TCG
cards.subtitle: West First Street corridor, Claremont Packing House
cards.notes: Visit the named card and trading-card-game shop at the Packing House, and use its official page for current product or event details.
cards.short_summary: A Packing House shop centered on sports cards and trading card games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village arts directory lists Lost Levels Sports Card Shop & TCG at 530 W. First St. in the Packing House.
cards.access_notes: Merchandise and any separately listed activities may require payment.
